biography:
As the Head of Data Centre Advisory EMEA at CBRE, I work with an expert team dedicated to providing clients with data centre solutions that enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and mitigate risk.

While my team leadership is focused on EMEA, my strategic and client responsibilities are global. I am heavily involved in sourcing high-demand, AI-ready data centre capacity for neoclouds and cloud service providers worldwide. Critically, I also personally own and manage CBRE's global strategic relationship with Nvidia, aligning our strategies to support the rapid growth in accelerated computing and AI infrastructure.

With over 20 years of experience spanning data centre strategy, digital transformation, infrastructure migration, and network services, I have a proven track record of delivering complex projects across diverse sectors. I am passionate about helping clients optimise their data centre performance and ensuring their IT infrastructure is a powerful enabler of their business goals.
